text: Attached is the Annual Report of the Toronto Lobbyist Registrar for the Year 2024.

City Council on July 23 and 24, 2025, adopted the following: 1. City Council request the Lobbyist Registrar, in consultation with the City Manager and the City Solicitor, to report back to the Executive Committee in the fourth quarter of 2025, on a potential amendment to the Lobbying By-law to clarify how it applies to participation in City-established roundtables, working groups, and advisory bodies. 2. City Council receive the Annual Report of the Toronto Lobbyist Registrar for the Year 2024 for information.
